messages.author: 4014fcc5a01bdb0a
messages.subject: Using local packages on Shinyapps.io
parts: I have created an R package that I want to use in my Shiny app.  It runs fine locally, but when I try to deploy to shinyapps.io this package causes it to fail.  Is there a way I can install a package from a local binary so that it can be uploaded to shinyapps.io?  Or if this is not possible, is there any other workaround (like installing from a private Github repo, or AWS)?  It's a proprietary package so I can't put it on CRAN.  At the moment I have things running by copying all the package scripts into my Shiny app directory, but I hope there is a better method than this.  Other than stating that all required packages must be installed locally, I couldn't find any good documentation on this topic.  -Elaine

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Using local packages on Shinyapps.io
parts:
Yes, we support private github repos.  Please let us know if you have any issues with that.

-Tareef
